title: Window extended-frame placement correction
summary: Recovered window-frame at VA 0x48CAB0 (123 bytes) as a genuine thiscall Window member and explicit platform API adapter. Loads dwmapi.dll, resolves DwmGetWindowAttribute, queries attribute 9 for the secondary HWND at +8 after GetWindowRect, adds only a signed-positive wrapped top difference to +0x20, and releases every successfully loaded module. Caller 0x48CD71 runs this after secondary-window creation and consumes +0x20 for placement. Original strings, imports, caller, and instructions inspected directly; assembled oracle checked equal to all 123 immutable executable bytes. No high-level matching claim.
test_description: GCC fixed-flag i386 freestanding build and execution passed 6912 cases. Local linker places accepted original_window_frame at 0x48CAB0 and accepted cookie-check at 0x8F8958, test import slots at 0x92D000, names at 0x9FBD50 and cookie at 0xBAABC0. Each case compares the portable adapter directly with original, then checks original-ABI member against it. Varies load/lookup availability, HRESULT 0/1/-1/INT_MIN, GetWindowRect BOOL 0/1 (always writes output), all pairs of top values 0,1,7,INT_MAX,INT_MIN,UINT_MAX, and six initial offsets. Verifies entire bounded object prefix plus surrounding canaries, wrapping arithmetic, exact callback ordering/count, HWND/module/name/attribute/size arguments, release on lookup/query failure, and ignored BOOL/release results. With unmapped test sections, submitted harness explicitly reports C++-only assertions and does not call unmapped original dependencies.
known_limits: Actual Windows DLL loading and desktop geometry are delegated platform dependencies; callbacks validate dispatch and transformation, not Windows implementation behavior.

Original stack rectangles are uninitialized. Successful queries that do not write required tops, including failed GetWindowRect without output, have indeterminate behavior and are not assigned a deterministic replacement or tested.
Local full-oracle tests require fixed data-section mappings described in test.cpp and test_description; a trusted link without these mappings runs adapter assertions only and reports this limitation.
Only the observed object prefix through +0x23 is modeled; class identity, remaining layout and other methods are unresolved. No return value is specified by the original void-like caller.
The member adapter snapshots import pointers before dispatch. Runtime modification of the IAT during a callback is outside tested behavior.
MSVC2013 syntax compatibility is provided; the optional MSVC tool was absent. Native Windows compilation and source-byte matching were not claimed.
